mapper.insert: INSERT INTO P_PROJECT_PROGRESS_INFO ( ID, PROJECT_ID, BEGIN_DATE, END_DATE, BEGIN_CHECK_DATE, END_CHECK_DATE, PLAN_DATE, COMPLETE_DATE, SETTLEMENT_DATE, AMOUNT, REMARK, CREATOR, CREATOR_NAME, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{beginCheckDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endCheckDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{planDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{completeDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{settlementDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{amount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatorName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=DATE} )
mapper.select: SELECT "PROJECT_ID", "AFTER_STATUS", "NEXT_DATE",CREATE_TIME,ID FROM (SELECT PROJECT_ID, AFTER_STATUS, NEXT_DATE,CREATE_TIME,ID, ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY PROJECT_ID, AFTER_STATUS ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC) AS ROWN FROM P_PROJECT_PROGRESS WHERE NEXT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND AFTER_STATUS IS NOT NULL) WHERE ROWN = 1

select count(*) from (SELECT "PROJECT_ID" FROM (SELECT PROJECT_ID, AFTER_STATUS, NEXT_DATE,CREATE_TIME,ID, ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY PROJECT_ID, AFTER_STATUS ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC) AS ROWN FROM P_PROJECT_PROGRESS WHERE NEXT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND AFTER_STATUS IS NOT NULL) WHERE ROWN = 1 group by "PROJECT_ID")
